traditions.LXX: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ .
traditions.KJV: A Psalm of Asaph .

1.english_reference: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance

traditions.WLC: אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם בְּֽ נַחֲלָתֶ֗ ךָ
traditions.LXX: Ὁ θεός , ἤλθοσαν ἔθνη εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν σου ,
traditions.VUL: Deus venérunt gentes in hereditátem tuam ,
traditions.KJV: O God , the heathen are come into thine inheritance ;

1.english_reference: thy holy temple have they defiled

traditions.LXX: ἐμίαναν τὸν ναὸν τὸν ἅγιόν σου ,
traditions.KJV: thy holy temple have they defiled ;

1.english_reference: they have laid Jerusalem on heaps

traditions.LXX: ἔθεντο Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς ὀπωροφυλάκιον ·
traditions.KJV: they have laid Jerusalem on heaps .

2.english_reference: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given meat unto the fowls of the heaven

traditions.WLC: נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗י ךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְ ע֣וֹף הַ שָּׁמָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: ἔθεντο τὰ θνησιμαῖα τῶν δούλων σου βρώματα τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Posuérunt morticína servórum tuórum , escas volatílibus cæli :
traditions.KJV: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given [ to be ] meat unto the fowls of the heaven ,

2.english_reference: the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth

traditions.WLC: בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗י ךָ לְ חַיְת וֹ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: τὰς σάρκας τῶν ὁσίων σου τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς ·
traditions.KJV: the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth .

3.english_reference: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ ם כַּ מַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם
traditions.LXX: ἐξέχεαν τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν ὡς ὕδωρ κύκλῳ Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: Effudérunt sánguinem eórum tamquam aquam in circúitu Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem ;

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ θάπτων .
traditions.KJV: and [ there was ] none to bury [ them ] .

4.english_reference: We are become a reproach to our neighbours

traditions.LXX: ἐγενήθημεν εἰς ὄνειδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν ,
traditions.KJV: We are become a reproach to our neighbours ,

4.english_reference: a scorn and derision to them that are round about us

traditions.WLC: לַ֥עַג וָ֝ קֶ֗לֶס לִ סְבִיבוֹתֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: μυκτηρισμὸς καὶ χλευασμὸς τοῖς κύκλῳ ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: subsannátio et illúsio his , qui in circúitu nostro sunt .
traditions.KJV: a scorn and derision to them that are round about us .

traditions.LXX: ἕως πότε , Κύριε ,
traditions.KJV: How long , LORD ?

5.english_reference: wilt thou be angry for ever ?

traditions.LXX: ὀργισθήσῃ εἰς τέλος ;
traditions.KJV: wilt thou be angry for ever ?

5.english_reference: shall thy jealousy burn like fire ?

traditions.LXX: ἐκκαυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ὁ ζῆλός σου ;
traditions.KJV: shall thy jealousy burn like fire ?

6.english_reference: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee

traditions.WLC: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְ ךָ֨ אֶֽל הַ גּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא יְדָ֫ע֥וּ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἔκχεον τὴν ὀργήν σου ἐπὶ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ ἐπεγνωκότα σε ,
traditions.VUL: Effúnde iram tuam in gentes , quæ te non novérunt :
traditions.KJV: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee ,

6.english_reference: and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝ שִׁמְ ךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ βασιλείας αἳ τὸ ὄνομά σου οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο ·
traditions.VUL: et in regna , quæ nomen tuum non invocavérunt :
traditions.KJV: and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name .

traditions.LXX: ὅτι κατέφαγον τὸν Ἰακώβ ,
traditions.KJV: For they have devoured Jacob ,

7.english_reference: and laid waste his dwelling place

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ ἠρήμωσαν .
traditions.KJV: and laid waste his dwelling place .

8.english_reference: O remember not against us former iniquities

traditions.WLC: אַֽל תִּזְכָּר לָ נוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים
traditions.LXX: μὴ μνησθῇς ἡμῶν ἀνομιῶν ἀρχαίων ·
traditions.KJV: O remember not against us former iniquities :

8.english_reference: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us

traditions.LXX: ταχὺ προκαταλαβέτωσαν ἡμᾶς οἱ οἰκτειρμοί σου ,
traditions.KJV: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us :

8.english_reference: for we are brought very low

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπτωχεύσαμεν σφόδρα .
traditions.KJV: for we are brought very low .

9.english_reference: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name

traditions.WLC: עָזְרֵ֤ נוּ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗ נוּ עַל דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד שְׁמֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: βοήθησον ἡμῖν , ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτὴρ ἡμῶν , ἕνεκα τῆς δόξης τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ·
traditions.VUL: Adiuva nos Deus salutáris noster : et propter glóriam nóminis tui
traditions.KJV: Help us , O God of our salvation , for the glory of thy name :

traditions.LXX: Κύριε , ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.KJV: and deliver us ,

9.english_reference: and purge away our sins, for thy name ’s sake

traditions.WLC: וְ כַפֵּ֥ר עַל חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗י נוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἱλάσθητι ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἡμῶν ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ·
traditions.VUL: et propítius esto peccátis nostris , propter nomen tuum .
traditions.KJV: and purge away our sins , for thy name ’s sake .

traditions.LXX: μή ποτε εἴπωσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν
traditions.KJV: Wherefore should the heathen say ,

traditions.LXX: Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν ;
traditions.KJV: Where [ is ] their God ?

10.english_reference: let him be known among the heathen in our sight

traditions.WLC: יִוָּדַ֣ע ב גיים לְ עֵינֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνωσθήτω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ἡμῶν
traditions.VUL: et innotéscat in natiónibus coram óculis nostris ,
traditions.KJV: let him be known among the heathen in our sight [ by ]

10.english_reference: [ by ] the revenging of the blood of thy servants [ which is ] shed .

traditions.WLC: נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם עֲבָדֶ֥י ךָ הַ שָּׁפֽוּךְ
traditions.LXX: ἡ ἐκδίκησις τοῦ αἵματος τῶν δούλων σου τοῦ ἐκκεχυμένου .
traditions.VUL: últio sánguinis servórum tuórum , qui effúsus est :
traditions.KJV: the revenging of the blood of thy servants [ which is ] shed .

11.english_reference: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee

traditions.WLC: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְ פָנֶי ךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר
traditions.LXX: εἰσελθάτω ἐνώπιόν σου ὁ στεναγμὸς τῶν πεπεδημένων ,
traditions.VUL: intróeat in conspéctu tuo gémitus compeditórum .
traditions.KJV: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee ;

11.english_reference: according to the greatness of thy power

traditions.LXX: κατὰ τὴν μεγαλωσύνην τοῦ βραχίονός σου ,
traditions.KJV: according to the greatness of thy power

11.english_reference: preserve thou those that are appointed to die

traditions.LXX: περιποίησαι τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν τεθανατωμένων .
traditions.KJV: preserve thou those that are appointed to die ;

12.english_reference: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִ שְׁכֵנֵ֣י נוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל חֵיקָ֑ ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ ם
traditions.LXX: ἀπόδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν ἑπταπλάσια εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτῶν , τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: Et redde vicínis nostris séptuplum in sinu eórum : impropérium ipsórum ,
traditions.KJV: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach ,

12.english_reference: wherewith they have reproached thee , O Lord

traditions.LXX: ὃν ὠνείδισάν σε , κύριε .
traditions.KJV: wherewith they have reproached thee , O Lord .

13.english_reference: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּ ךָ֨ וְ צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶ ךָ֮
traditions.LXX: ἡμεῖς γὰρ λαός σου καὶ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς σου
traditions.VUL: Nos autem pópulus tuus , et oves páscuæ tuæ ,
traditions.KJV: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture

13.english_reference: will give thee thanks for ever

traditions.LXX: ἀνθομολογησόμεθά σοι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ,
traditions.KJV: will give thee thanks for ever :

13.english_reference: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations

traditions.WLC: לְ דֹ֥ר וָ דֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἐξαγγελοῦμεν τὴν αἴνεσίν σου .
traditions.VUL: in generatiónem et generatiónem annuntiábimus laudem tuam .
traditions.KJV: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations .
